Issue for Consideration Whether the appellant, who was not a party to the settlement between the second respondent-BCCI (Operational Creditor) and the Corporate Debtor, has locus in the proceedings before this Court; whether the NCLAT erred in invoking its inherent of the NCLAT Rules 2016 in the presence of a prescribed procedure for withdrawal of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and settlement of claims between parties; and without prejudice to the above, whether the NCLAT adequately addressed the objections raised by the appellant, while
